high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "bigsmall.in." The post appears to be sponsored, as indicated by the label "Sponsored" below the username. The post features a close-up photograph of a necklace with a watch pendant. The watch has a round face with intricate designs, and it is adorned with two golden wings attached to its sides, resembling the Golden Snitch from the Harry Potter series. The background of the photo shows a wooden surface, possibly a table or a box, which adds a rustic and warm feel to the image.
